_methodology: Stratified sample (every-4th fixup + retouched + window-complete clean picks). Each flagged pair inspected via git show --stat + diff region check on the claimed follow-up. Truth rule: fixup = the later fix plausibly repairs a fault THIS commit introduced (footprint + topic coherence), not mere file churn. retouched = re-touched >=2x in window without repair intent. Labeled 2026-09-11 against linkage code-files-v3.
_known_limits: recall not measurable from this sample (all labeler-flagged commits + controls; missed fixups would need full-history annotation). reverted class: 0 occurrences in corpus — precision/recall not computable. 85fd9dd relabeled to retouched on re-inspection: the diff-impact merge-base fault predated it (the commit added the oracle that EXPOSED it, did not introduce it). 4f0133a is the residual boundary case: b5cd002's hunks literally intersect 4f0133a's mcp_server.py:420-422 edits (pack tool description text both commits rewrote) — region overlap cannot distinguish repair from adjacent doc edits.
